u0: This is the neutral tracking phase: no single lane-group breach is currently recorded as the active one-sided condition. To keep the preference, at least one group—the top lane or the side lanes—must remain completely free of breaches; a top-only breach shifts tracking to a top-breach phase, and a side-only breach shifts it to a side-breach phase. If top and side breaches happen together, the preference is broken on that step and the neutral phase is retained, and this phase is also where tracking returns after both groups have been breached, so it does not by itself mean that no breach has ever happened. The episode continues regardless, and the agent should keep defending both lane groups so that a breach of one group is not later paired with a breach of the other.

Further top-lane breaches do not change this phase, and the earlier top-lane breach is historical rather than a sign that a zombie is currently there. The agent should therefore concentrate on the side lanes where possible while still continuing to defend the top lane.
